new inputs require complete output grids."},{"id":4,"choice":"Partly","comment":"Two attempts, settings and spending limits are described, but conditions differ across testing routes."},{"id":5,"choice":"Yes","comment":"Exact matches earn input credit; input fractions are averaged within problems and then across problems."},{"id":6,"choice":"Yes","comment":"Inferring hidden rules from examples is explicitly linked to reasoning beyond factual recall."},{"id":7,"choice":"Partly","comment":"Puzzle origins, human difficulty selection and duplicate-rule review are explained; broader representativeness is not established."},{"id":8,"choice":"Yes","comment":"Developers reviewed puzzles, and subsequent corrections document checks of grids and examples."},{"id":9,"choice":"Partly","comment":"The puzzles exercise rule inference and idea combination, but evidence covers only two-dimensional grids."},{"id":10,"choice":"Partly","comment":"Exact output matching directly measures successful completion, but excludes credit for partially correct grids and does not establish the reasoning used."},{"id":11,"choice":"Not sure","comment":"The averaging rule is described, but evidence supporting that weighting as an ability measure is not supplied."},{"id":12,"choice":"Partly","comment":"Public marking tests cover several correct and incorrect output cases; complete marking-system validation is not established."},{"id":13,"choice":"Partly","comment":"Human solving results inform difficulty and AI scores provide comparisons, but human findings include a larger pool than the final test."},{"id":14,"choice":"Not sure","comment":"Verified testing uses one run; no repeated-run study of AI score variation is supplied."},{"id":15,"choice":"Not sure","comment":"No systematic study of instruction, presentation or software changes is supplied."},{"id":16,"choice":"Not sure","comment":"The reviewed materials provide no estimates or ranges for repeated-run score variation."},{"id":17,"choice":"Partly","comment":"Developers addressed program-search shortcuts and repeated solution rules, without ruling out every unintended route."},{"id":18,"choice":"Partly","comment":"Hidden-data agreements and exposure monitoring address risk, while public questions remain accessible and leakage remains possible."},{"id":19,"choice":"Partly","comment":"Development training is allowed and evaluation-specific tuning and feedback-driven repetition are discouraged; comprehensive enforcement is not established."},{"id":20,"choice":"Not sure","comment":"No study links scores to language, social interaction or real-world work."},{"id":21,"choice":"Partly","comment":"Verified settings and human difficulty matching support some comparisons; other testing routes differ."},{"id":22,"choice":"Partly","comment":"Public problems, software and marking tests support inspection; hidden tasks are controlled and the complete output archive was not checked."},{"id":23,"choice":"Yes","comment":"The passage states the public licence and hidden-data confidentiality, provider-handling and submission-review rules."},{"id":24,"choice":"Partly","comment":"Dated records identify problem and code corrections, but affected AI scores are not comprehensively recalculated."},{"id":25,"choice":"Partly","comment":"Grid-solving comparisons have direct support; connections to broader intelligence exceed the supplied validation."}],"instrument_review":"The questions distinguish documented procedures from evidence supporting score interpretations. For ARC-AGI-2, exact grid matching supports a clear task outcome, while broader reasoning interpretations require additional evidence. Items about whether testing occurred should credit documented checks without implying comprehensive validation.","supported_claims":["Scores describe exact grid-output success under the specified attempts and scoring rules.","Human solving studies informed test-set difficulty matching.","Public materials permit inspection of problems and marking behavior."],"documented_problems":["Software awards fractional problem credit, while the dataset reserves 'fully solved' for all inputs being correct.","Public corrections identify faulty squares and unclear examples.","Verified evaluations use one run, and revisions do not trigger comprehensive score recalculation."],"missing_information":["Repeated-run variability and sensitivity to instructions or presentation.","Evidence predicting performance beyond grid puzzles.","Validation of score weighting and comprehensive marking-system accuracy."],"reinterpretations":["Read the score as an average of within-problem input success fractions.","Human difficulty matching does not establish AI score stability.","Exposure precautions reduce risk without proving an AI has never seen the problems."],"closing_note":"The instrument leaves unclear how extensive checks must be for Yes on marking validation. 'Solved' also requires clarification because software credit and full-problem completion differ."},{"benchmark":"designqa","mesa_answers":[{"id":1,"choice":"Yes","comment":"The original 2024 benchmark, 1,451 question-answer pairs and public scoring software are identified."},{"id":2,"choice":"Yes","comment":"Engineering-rule retrieval, drawing understanding, rule application and intended AI comparisons are described."},{"id":3,"choice":"Yes","comment":"Six task groups, supplied rules or images, and required text or yes/no answers are results."},{"id":5,"choice":"Yes","comment":"Text similarity, decision accuracy and equal weighting of six groups are described."},{"id":6,"choice":"Yes","comment":"The authors connect tasks to parts of engineering work as their rationale for measuring document understanding."},{"id":7,"choice":"Partly","comment":"Real competition materials and practitioner contributions justify relevance, but one rulebook and uneven groups limit coverage."},{"id":8,"choice":"Partly","comment":"Two additional reviewers checked manually written questions, with exceptions and more limited explanation checks."},{"id":9,"choice":"Partly","comment":"Six groups cover several relevant activities, but one rulebook and limited task types constrain the claimed coverage."},{"id":10,"choice":"Partly","comment":"Correct decisions reflect task success, but commas, wording and omitted valid rules can affect credit."},{"id":11,"choice":"Not sure","comment":"Equal group weighting is specified, but support for the combined score or distinct skill interpretations is not supplied."},{"id":12,"choice":"Partly","comment":"Small marking tests and scoring-error discussions show some checking, without a complete accuracy and consistency study."},{"id":13,"choice":"Partly","comment":"Random guessing and other AI results provide context, but no human engineer baseline is reported and information supply differs."},{"id":14,"choice":"Not sure","comment":"Five passage sets were tested for one AI, but changing passages does not isolate repeated-run variation under identical conditions."},{"id":15,"choice":"Yes","comment":"The authors tested changes to supplied passages, dimension labels, scale bars and image highlighting."},{"id":16,"choice":"Partly","comment":"Passage variation provides some information, but uncertainty is insufficient for close main-model comparisons."},{"id":17,"choice":"Partly","comment":"Formatting, retrieval and component familiarity were examined, but unintended strategies were not fully tested."},{"id":18,"choice":"Partly","comment":"Image novelty and possible exposure were discussed, but systematic overlap checks and a protected test set were not established."},{"id":19,"choice":"Not sure","comment":"Clear rules for training on questions and repeated submissions were unavailable in the reviewed sources."},{"id":20,"choice":"Not sure","comment":"No evidence establishes prediction of success on other technical documents or engineering projects."},{"id":21,"choice":"Partly","comment":"Information-supply differences are described, but systems receiving full rules and retrieved passages face different conditions."},{"id":22,"choice":"Partly","comment":"Public materials support inspection, but historical software, settings and inputs are not fully linked to every result."},{"id":23,"choice":"Not sure","comment":"The reviewer did not find a licence file or complete responsible-reuse rules."},{"id":24,"choice":"Partly","comment":"Code history identifies revisions, but their effects on scores lack a clear change record."},{"id":25,"choice":"Partly","comment":"The paper acknowledges scope and marking limits, while broader engineering interpretations and close rankings need additional support."}],"instrument_review":"The questions reveal that practical source materials alone do not validate engineering competence claims. DesignQA supports comparisons on specified tasks, but scoring artifacts, unequal information supply and limited uncertainty evidence constrain interpretation. The instrument should distinguish tests that occurred from whether their coverage was sufficient.","supported_claims":["The benchmark examines six task types using Formula SAE rules and vehicle materials.","Some changes to information supply and visual presentation were tested.","Results describe systems together with the information supplied to them."],"documented_problems":["Formatting and missing valid reference rules can affect credit.","All described scale-bar drawings comply, so always answering yes would earn decision credit on that portion.","One released answer file has fewer rows than the paper's corresponding question count.","Historical evaluation details are incompletely linked to results."],"missing_information":["Identical-condition repeated-run variation and adequate uncertainty for close comparisons.","Comprehensive marking validation and justification of equal group weighting.","Clear training, submission and reuse rules.","Evidence of transfer to other documents or engineering projects."],"reinterpretations":["Treat scores as performance on these tasks under the stated information conditions.","The always-yes opportunity does not establish that any evaluated AI exploited it.","Missing reuse documentation does not establish that reuse is prohibited.","Five different passage sets test setup variation rather than identical-condition repetition."],"closing_note":"Items on testing should clarify that limited checks still count as testing. The questionnaire also leaves thresholds for sufficient uncertainty, fair comparisons and justified score weighting open to reviewer judgment."}]}
